The biggest problem is: How can students who ALREADY know too much about this language  take the first level of the language? How is this allowed? And since the majority of the class already knows the language, how does the instructor of the course adjust his way of teaching according to them? I was very angry with him because of this. While he should 've given priority to those who don't know the Korean language, he literally ignored us and focused on those who already knew the language. And he always wants us to split into groups and talk to each other in every hour of the course. How will we speak when we don't know the language yet? I hated those group talking moments. I almost hate Nam Hoca's teaching. Instead of teaching, he constantly played music videos and songs in the class. Our time has gona wasted for nothing. Nam Hoca is a really good person.
